name: Dabur India Ltd.
business_summary: Ayurvedic and natural-health FMCG: healthcare (Chyawanprash, Honey, Hajmola, Dabur Red), home & personal care (Odonil, Odomos, Dabur Amla, Vatika), foods (Real juices, Badshah spices acquired 2023), and Sesa Care (merger approved by NCLT 25 Sep 2026). International ~25% of revenue (Middle East, Egypt, Turkey, Nigeria, Bangladesh; approximate). Promoters (Burman family) own 66.25%. Q2 FY27 PAT ~Rs 499-506 cr (+12%); global CEO Mohit Malhotra resigned on 4 Nov 2026 (effective 13 Nov), successor Herjit Singh Bhalla.

exposures.mechanism: Rural ~45% of India sales (company disclosure, model knowledge). +5pp rural growth => sales +2.1% x 35% incremental margin/18% => EBITDA +4.1%, persistence 0.5 => +2.0. Dabur said in Oct 2026 that rural outpaces urban.

evidence.note: Moneycontrol: FMCG growth accelerates, rural demand outpaces urban

exposures.mechanism: Urban ~55% of India sales; +5pp => sales +2.7% x 35% / 18% => EBITDA +5.2% x 0.5 = +2.6, trimmed to +1.5 for overlap and weaker urban premium mix.
Packaging ~12% of costs (glass/PET/cartons for Real, honey, hair oil). +10% => costs +1.2% => 0.98% of sales => EBITDA -5.4%; 50% pass-through => -2.7; persistence 0.5 => -1.4.

evidence.note: Business Standard: rising input costs weigh on FMCG margins

exposures.mechanism: Coconut/vegetable oils (Anmol, Vatika) ~6% of costs. +10% => costs +0.6% => 0.49% of sales => EBITDA -2.7%; 50% passthrough, persistence 0.5 => -0.7.
Sugar/fruit concentrates for Real juices ~4% of costs. +10% => EBITDA -1.8%; 50% passthrough; persistence 0.5 => -0.4. Sugar +27.8% since June.
Light liquid paraffin, surfactants, PET ~5% of costs. +10% Brent => EBITDA -1.4%; 50% pass-through; persistence 0.5 => -0.35; empirical -0.73 (t=-1.7) is larger, blended to -0.6.
International ~20-25% of revenue in USD-linked/volatile currencies; weaker rupee raises translated profit but Egypt/Turkey/Nigeria depreciation offsets. Net +0.5, low confidence.
P/E 33.7, low debt (interest Rs 40 cr per quarter), 70% payout: valuation channel => -1.0 per +25bp.

Hair oil, shampoo, ayurvedic products were moved to lower GST slabs in the Sept 2025 reform (model knowledge); a further cut is a small positive; +1 => volume +1.5% => EBITDA +2.9% x 0.5 persistence => +1.0 (conservative given partial price relief).

Honey, juices and spice products are exposed to FSSAI sampling; Nestle/Zydus notices (Oct 2026) show enforcement intensity rising. +1 => ~2% of sales disrupted => EBITDA -0.8%... probability-weighted => -0.5.

evidence.note: FSSAI notices to Nestle and Zydus Wellness

supply_chain.note: hair oil, oral care, health foods

company_events.event: CEO Mohit Malhotra steps down; Herjit Singh Bhalla takes over (global CEO transition)
Q3 FY27 results (Oct-Dec); winter portfolio (chyawanprash) and rural recovery

current_state.trend: volume growth accelerating, rural ahead of urban; margins steady at ~18%
